gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 Syndicate 2987 reported opening gross claims outstanding of $3,314.9m and recorded a net prior-year release on gross claims of $34.9m (a 1.05% reduction of opening gross claims). The release is driven by favourable claims development on prior underwriting years. The year was nevertheless impacted by a number of significant 2016 catastrophe events (Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods and Gatlinburg wildfires) which increased the combined ratio for the year but were current-year losses rather than prior-year reserve deterioration.
